project.code-ai.detail.about: CodeAi is my graduation project. It brings programming courses, exercises, a browser-based code editor and an AI chat into one application.
project.code-ai.detail.stack: The interface uses React and Vite, and the server uses Node.js and Express.js. The code editor uses Monaco Editor. Ollama connects the app to language models.
project.code-ai.detail.feature.editor.te: A code editor built with Monaco Editor.

project.code-ai.detail.feature.assistant: An AI chat interface inside the application.

project.ai-miky.detail.about: AI Miky is a Flutter app with an AI chat, a user profile and settings for the interface and assistant.
project.ai-miky.detail.stack: Flutter and Dart provide the interface. The app uses Firebase and integrates Gemini API, OpenAI and Ollama.
project.ai-miky.detail.feature.chat.text: A dedicated chat screen with prompts to start a conversation.
project.ai-miky.detail.feature.profile.t: A separate screen for profile information.

project.contextos.title: ContextOS
project.contextos.description: A CLI that selects engineering rules for a task, exports them to coding agents and checks configuration drift.
project.contextos.detail.subtitle: Check which rule changes reached Cursor and Claude Code.
project.contextos.example.rule: Item names are limited to 80 characters
project.contextos.example.explanation: The edited rule sets a limit on the length of the normalized name.
project.contextos.detail.about: ContextOS keeps engineering rules in a shared source. Its CLI selects rules for a task and exports configurations for coding agents, so the same rules can be maintained across tools.
project.contextos.detail.stack: Built with JavaScript and Node.js. The CLI is published as contextos-agents on npm, with an accompanying contextos-mcp package.
project.contextos.detail.feature.rules.t: Selects the relevant rules for a task instead of adding the full rule set to every agent session.
project.contextos.detail.feature.exports: Generates agent-specific configuration from a shared set of rules.
project.contextos.detail.feature.drift.t: Checks whether generated configurations match the source rules.
project.story-forecaster.title: Story Forecaster
project.story-forecaster.description: A Python API for story continuation experiments, with chapter retrieval, cutoff filters and separate branches.
project.story-forecaster.detail.subtitle: To continue a story after chapter five, the API looks for clues in the first five chapters only.
project.story-forecaster.workflow.chapte: Events from chapter six onward stay outside the search.
project.story-forecaster.workflow.search: The query retrieves relevant passages from the available chapters.
The model uses those passages to propose a continuation.
project.story-forecaster.workflow.branch: The new version is saved separately from the original story.
project.story-forecaster.detail.about: Story Forecaster retrieves relevant passages from imported chapters and uses Gemini to generate continuations. Experiments run in separate branches, with changes to story state validated before they are saved.
project.story-forecaster.detail.stack: Built with Python, FastAPI and SQLite. BM25 retrieves passages, and Gemini generates continuations. Tests use pytest.
BM25 finds passages from imported chapters for the generation context.
Filters retrieved passages by chapter number when testing a continuation from an earlier point in the story.
Keeps alternative continuations in isolated branches and validates story-state changes before saving them.
